purpose: The exact required set per environment class and per service role. Dependencies mirror the SPEC-007 section 7.2 table; credentials mirror PREFLIGHT.md and the lane classification in config/environment/schema.json. sh scripts/config-validate.sh re-derives both sides and fails on any drift, so this file cannot quietly disagree with the specification it mirrors.
derived_from: SPEC-007 section 7.2 (the dependency/role table; parsed by the guard, not restated from memory)

clean-local.note: A developer or CI machine with the disposable local services. The audience values are NOT required here, because no local path mints or validates a real token yet: they become required at the E2E lane.

staging.note: A deployed non-production stack: every credential whose lane is at or before REQUIRED_BEFORE_DEPLOY.

production.note: The credential requirement is identical to staging; the deployment itself is manual and authorized by a named operator (SPEC-008 section 9), and nothing in this repository may perform it.

web.credentials_note: The five variables of src/infrastructure/config.ts REQUIRED_VARIABLES plus the object-store credentials, because object-store is required for this role by SPEC-007 section 7.2. The audience values are required before E2E rather than at startup for this role.

worker.credentials_note: The same storage and secret material as the web role, without the Keycloak credentials, because SPEC-007 section 7.2 makes keycloak-jwks NOT required for this role. The provider keys the worker role reaches through provider-transport are OPTIONAL entitlements in PREFLIGHT.md, so they are declared and not required; a missing entitlement fails closed at the transport and is reported as BLOCKED_CREDENTIALS rather than substituted.

optional_dependency_notes.job-worker: Required for NO role, by design: a stalled worker fleet must be visible in the readiness body without taking the web tier down (SPEC-007 section 7.2). It is reported, never silently dropped.

not_required_anywhere.CLOUD_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY: OPTIONAL: required only by a deployment that resolves outbound credentials by workload identity.
not_required_anywhere.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET: OPTIONAL: required only where the payment webhook is enabled.
not_required_anywhere.CODEX_RUNNER_HANDLE: HUMAN_EXTERNAL: no stage in this graph delegates to an external runner.
not_required_anywhere.PORT: Has a default; 0 binds no port.
not_required_anywhere.VANISHGRAPH_METRICS_PORT: Has a default of 0, which starts no metrics listener.
not_required_anywhere.VG_COMMIT: Has a default of the literal token unknown.
not_required_anywhere.VG_REPLAY_LOG: Has a default path in a temporary directory.
not_required_anywhere.RECIPE_VERIFICATION_KEYS: Absent means recipe signatures cannot be verified, which the recipe guard already treats as unverifiable rather than fresh.
not_required_anywhere.VG_TEST_DSN_OWNER: Test-only, read by the migration stage.
not_required_anywhere.VG_TEST_DSN_APP: Test-only, read by the integration stage.
